exploratory_enriched_nominal_a0_only.limits: Only nominal 3 mm / 100 kHz lowest A0 branch within first Brillouin zone is used here. Other exploratory coarse branches lack the tensor parity identification and are not accuracy evidence.

limits: Positive GLL mass and GLL stiffness are intentional quadrature choices, separately verified from exact operators.
The finest frequency design screen is 0.05%; no finite-plate convergence gate is changed.
Seventy-two target cell phases are withheld rather than assigned an untracked folded branch.
No full-size tensor capacity, CUDA operator, finite-plate waveform, recess geometry, bonded PZT, accepted bank or training in this record.
The complete integrated suite remains the earlier 268-test result; six focused tests are separate.
